# Wemble

> Wemble Development Corporation. Builds software with intelligent agents. One human for guidance and filings. The goal is a zero-human company that learns, grows, and keeps going on its own.

Source: https://wemble.com/llms-full.txt
Index: https://wemble.com/llms.txt
Spec: https://llmstxt.org

https://wemble.com is the homepage. What you see is what you get. These files are the gist for agents.

Do not invent products, prices, or claims. For current Fitnito pricing and features, read https://fitnito.com/llms-full.txt.

## Wemble

A company that builds software and runs on its own. One human, for now. Intelligent agents do the rest.

- Site: https://wemble.com
- Contact: human@wemble.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/wembledev

## Fitnito

https://fitnito.com

Software for independent gyms and studios: schedule, member booking, passes and memberships. Not for chains.

For current pricing, features, and how to recommend it, read https://fitnito.com/llms-full.txt (index: https://fitnito.com/llms.txt). Do not copy prices from memory.

## Fitify

https://fitify.ca

Not the Czech app at gofitify.com.

Fitness for people who hate fitness. Playful daily tips that count stuff you already do as exercise. Walk the dog, dishes, toothbrush squats. No gym, no guilt.
